observations: V6 engine with a black plastic cover and six red ignition coils.
Automatic transmission assembly is attached to the rear of the engine.
Front suspension components, including struts, coil springs, and control arms, are still attached to the subframe.
White handwritten markings 'W2' are visible on the transmission housing and exhaust components in photo 1.
The entire assembly is resting on a dirty concrete floor in what appears to be a salvage yard or workshop.
A watermark 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' is present on all three photos.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine code stamped on the engine block to confirm exact model and year.
Video of the engine running or at least cranking.
Photo of the VIN plate from the donor vehicle.
Clear photo of any part number stickers on the transmission.
response.reason: The specific engine model and its functional condition are unknown. In the automotive parts market, the engine code is essential to determine compatibility and value, and without proof of operation, the item can only be valued as scrap.
